evals.prompt: Make a 6-second 1920x1080 MP4 title card announcing 'Ledger 2.0 — reconciliation in seconds, not hours'. Dark, restrained, no stock-looking effects. Put the output in ./out.
evals.expected_output: A brief with a beat table, a seek(t) page, a check that passes, a contact sheet the agent looked at, and out/*.mp4 of 180 frames at 1920x1080.
expectations: A brief or beat table with times is written before or alongside the page
The page exposes window.seek(t) and window.DURATION = 6, and seek keeps no state between calls
render.py check was run and its final run passes
A contact sheet or stills were rendered and the agent reports looking at specific times
The MP4 is H.264, 1920x1080, 6 s, 180 frames, as confirmed by the video gate or ffprobe
The copy appears exactly as given, with no invented claims or numbers
The report states assumptions (font, palette) and the rerun commands

evals.prompt: Our README needs a looping GIF, 960x540, showing monthly active users for Jan-Jun as bars that grow in and then morph into a line chart through the same values. Numbers: 1200, 1450, 1390, 1810, 2240, 2600. Keep the file small.
evals.expected_output: A seamless GIF loop in which bars morph into a line through the given values, with check --loop passing and the file size reported.
expectations: All six values are plotted exactly as given, with labels and axes that stay fixed while the marks move
The bars transform into the line (the same points), rather than crossfading between two pictures
The GIF uses a reduced frame rate (12-20 fps) and a flat palette or --dither none, and its size is reported
The first frame of the GIF is a readable picture, not an empty frame

evals.prompt: Create a 1200x630 PNG social preview image for a blog post titled 'Why our queue lost messages (and the one-line fix)'. Use our colours: ink #0B1F33, accent #F2A541, paper #FAF7F2.
evals.expected_output: A still composition at 1200x630 using the given palette, rendered at 2x scale, and inspected.
expectations: The page is a still (DURATION absent or 0), and the output is rendered at 2400x1260 (scale 2) or at 1200x630, as stated in the report
Only the three given colours are used, plus tints of them
The full title is legible, with no clipping, and sits inside the safe area
The agent looked at the rendered PNG before reporting
No invented logo or brand mark is drawn
